title: Route one marked CRT payload fiber from encoded source
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The live encoded CRT leaf from #7352 now drives the existing Beneš row query and literal radix mover on the released nonroot fixture from #5625. The forward leg moves the four physical tags from `293,730,905,3681` to `730,293,905,3681`. The inverse restores the payload, its position keys, the encoded source and their heads. Both padded slots keep their tags.

The adapter reads width and modulus from the live source and takes the offset from the paid numerical lease. It enumerates the physical positions on tape, writes the row destinations into the radix keys and runs two literal passes in each direction. `RESULT.json` records the headers, separate execution counts and retained backing. This establishes one finite payload fiber. It does not establish a full integer product or a lower κ.

## Task and overlap

Refined scope under `uniform-transfer-audit` (priority revision 8). The fixture and retirement boundary are pinned to #5625 at `c36a72644322913866041e061912893a8f210ad5`; the four retained pending runtime modules are byte-exact from #7352 at `8c0e55c9ba25ff2c8199b01539a4d56ae71a1473`. #7351 supplies the same forward writer. The new join consumes those actual headers in the retained #5092, #5496 and #5015 payload path. See [the scoped Discussion #4709 claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19557643).

The research commit is based on canonical `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, with the two unchanged #7257 onboarding prerequisites already used by #7374 and #7379 (`bb36fc65e`, `d2e54af81`). `INPUT-PINS.json` records the exact bytes and paths of the 12 canonical inputs and four pending modules.

## Validation

Run `python3.12 -I -B research/encoded-crt-leaf-payload/replay.py`. A separate direct CRT oracle checks forward placement before exact restoration. Suppressed switches, wrong layer order and a truncated row stream have explicit controls. The registered and optimized replays pass; the committed package passes byte, mode and source history preflight and replays from a checked Git-free export.

## Credit

CubeJerry (#7351, #7352), Ali Romman (#5625) and JoyboyBrian (#5092, #5496, #5015). OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro materially assisted. Pro independently obtained the same placement and restoration with a different key-address policy. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Replay one retained mixed-width fixture with more than one right axis and check that the ordered row and header streams move every marked record and retire each borrow. Synchronization across fibers, a combined literal tariff and integer recovery remain open.
